# CLAUDE.md

## Package Manager

Use **pnpm** (not npm/yarn) for all commands: `pnpm install`, `pnpm run dev`, `pnpm run build`, etc.

## Plans

Save all design docs and implementation plans to `plans/` at the repo root. This directory is gitignored.

## Auto-Generated Files (Do NOT commit)

The following files are auto-generated and gitignored. Never `git add -f` them:

- `frontend/helpers/blog.json` — generated from blog markdown frontmatter
- `sitemap*.xml`, `robots.txt` — generated by Next.js build
- `next-env.d.ts`, `*.tsbuildinfo` — TypeScript build artifacts
- `frontend/dist/`, `.vinext/`, `.wrangler/` — vinext / Cloudflare build output
- `gh/data/` — generated by `pnpm run star:generate` in `gh/`

## Tech Stack

**App (vinext on Cloudflare Workers):** Vite 8 · vinext (Pages Router) · React ^19 · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · D3.js · fetch (GitHub API) · linkedom + SVGO (chart SVG) · `@cf-wasm/og` (landscape OG cards) · LRU cache · Wrangler

**Data pipelines (`gh/`):** SQLite + BigQuery / GH Archive.

## Project Structure

| Directory | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `frontend/` | Unified vinext app (UI + `/svg` API) |
| `shared/` | Chart/API/types shared with the app (`@shared/*`) |
| `gh/` | Star ranking + event data pipelines |

### Shared (`shared/`)

Imported via `@shared/*` (tsconfig + vite alias). Root `package.json` holds shared deps (d3, lodash).

| Directory | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `common/utils.tsx` | Cross-platform utilities |
| `common/api.tsx` | GitHub API client (fetch) |
| `common/chart.tsx` | Chart data transformation |
| `packages/xy-chart.tsx` | D3 XY chart renderer |
| `packages/radar-svg.ts` | Pure-math radar SVG |
| `packages/card-landscape1.tsx` | OG card layout builder |
| `types/` | TypeScript types |

### Frontend (`frontend/`)

| Directory | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `pages/` | Pages Router routes |
| `pages/api/` | `/svg`, `/healthz` (rewrites from root paths) |
| `server/` | Cache, tokens, OG rendering helpers |
| `components/` | React UI |
| `store/` | Context + URL hash sync |
| `helpers/` | Utils + `SITE_URL` / `API_URL` |
| `assets/` | Fonts + logo for OG cards |

## Routes

| Route | File | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `/` | `pages/index.tsx` | Home chart viewer |
| `/:owner/:repo` | `pages/[...slug].tsx` | Repo detail |
| `/svg` | `pages/api/svg.ts` | README chart / landscape OG SVG |
| `/healthz` | `pages/api/healthz.ts` | Health + cache stats |
| 404 | `pages/404.tsx` | Custom 404 |

Embeds use the same origin (`SITE_URL` === `API_URL`).

## Dev / Build / Deploy

```bash
# Local
cd frontend && pnpm i && pnpm dev

# Production build (local check)
cd frontend && pnpm run build

# Deploy to Cloudflare Workers
cd frontend && pnpm run deploy
```

CI: `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` runs `gh` JSON generation → `pnpm run build` → `pnpm run deploy`.

Required GitHub Actions secrets: `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`, `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID`.  
Worker secret (set once via wrangler): `GITHUB_TOKEN`.

## GH (Data Pipelines)

- **Full run**: `cd gh && pnpm run star:fetch`
- **Generate only**: `cd gh && pnpm run star:generate` — writes `gh/data/*.json` from `star.db`

## Visual Style Guide

xkcd / hand-drawn aesthetic — see tooltip + frame conventions in historical docs; tooltips use `xkcdify` filter and xkcd font.
